report.title: Target Dummies crash the game when saved in editor
report.body:
### Platforms

Windows

### Build

bleeding-edge build 27733

### Issue

If a Target Dummy is placed in the editor and the map is saved, the game crashes. The map also causes an error if it is attempted to be loaded afterwards.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Place a target dummy in the editor
2. Save the map

### Mods used

None

### Save file

(As described above, this map is unloadable in-game.)
[dummy.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31756506/dummy.zip)

### (Crash) logs

[crash-report-09_02_2026_16_06_14.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31756477/crash-report-09_02_2026_16_06_14.txt)

spec.summary: Reported crash when saving an editor map containing a Target Dummy; the saved map is also reported to produce an error when loaded afterward.
spec.bug_class: Crash / editor save and subsequent map-load failure
spec.observed_behavior: On Windows, the reporter states that placing a Target Dummy in the editor and saving the map crashes the game. The reporter further states that attempting to load the resulting saved map produces an error.
spec.expected_behavior: Saving an editor map containing a Target Dummy should complete without crashing, and the saved map should load without an error.
known_preconditions: Reporter states no mods were used.
A Target Dummy is placed in an editor map before saving.
uncertain_conditions: Whether build 27733 exactly corresponds to the supplied target commit.
Exact Windows version, architecture, graphics configuration, and Java/runtime details.
Whether the issue occurs with a new blank map or depends on map settings, rules, content, or prior editor actions.
Whether the crash occurs immediately on save, during save completion, or after a particular save-related action (for example, save dialog confirmation or overwrite).
Exact error shown when loading the saved map.
Whether the attached map archive contains the exact map produced by the reported reproduction steps.
Whether the crash is reproducible on Linux; Linux is listed as planned evaluation, not as a reported affected platform.
Whether Target Dummy refers to a built-in unit/block/content item and its exact internal content identifier.
Whether the save was a new map save or an overwrite of an existing map.
Whether any non-mod local configuration, custom content, or altered game files were present.
reproduction_hints: Use the reported bleeding-edge build 27733, or first verify its relationship to commit f7ededb3a1950c396e5c113d96a19dd88e71da9a.
On Windows, create or open an editor map, place a Target Dummy, and save the map.
After the save attempt, attempt to load the resulting map and record any displayed error.
Test both a new blank map and the supplied map artifact if it is available and safe to inspect.
Capture whether the behavior differs between saving a new file and overwriting an existing map.
required_artifacts: The referenced dummy.zip attachment, including the exact map file and archive contents.
Full crash stack trace/log output in text form, including game version, runtime, and timestamps.
The exact map-load error message and associated logs.
Editor map metadata/settings: map size, mode, rules, tags, and any custom objectives or scripts.
Exact Target Dummy content identifier and placement details.
Environment details: Windows version, game distribution/channel, Java/runtime version, and relevant launch arguments.
Confirmation of the exact executable/build hash used during reproduction.
If Linux is evaluated, corresponding Linux reproduction outcome and logs.

hypotheses.statement: Saving a newly created editor map after placing a Target Dummy crashes or leaves a map that errors on load.
hypotheses.prediction: The save confirmation will cause a crash/error, or re-opening that saved map will show an error.
hypotheses.observation: A blank map named DummySaveTest was created, Target Dummy selected and placed, then Save Map was clicked. The process exited with code 1. The log reports NullPointerException in TargetDummy$TargetDummyBuild.write because unitTeam is null.

Switch editor palette to block placement
Select Target Dummy block from results
Place selected Target Dummy on blank map
